cohort: The study included 146 patients diagnosed with acute fatty liver of pregnancy without hepatic/malignant diseases, collected from Qilu Hospital of Shandong University between 2007-2019, aged 20-41 years.
finding: Patients with acute fatty liver of pregnancy who received prenatal blood transfusions had reduced gestational ages and more severe clinical symptoms, with blood transfusion showing a significant association with adverse maternal (P=0.044) and highly significant association with fetal outcomes (P<0.001).
